name: Sail Newport Summer Youth Sailing Programs
description_short: Summer sailing classes for ages 5-17 at Fort Adams in Newport, RI. Two-week dinghy sessions (ages 7-17) and one-week keelboat sessions (ages 12-17) run from beginner to advanced, and Little Guppies is a short one-week introduction for 5- and 6-year-olds. Families apply online and are placed by experience, age and size.
refund_policy_summary: Once a student is accepted and paid: no obligation if they can't attend at the payment deadline (usually March). Cancel before the mid-April cutoff (April 12 in the 2026 policy) for a refund minus a $30 fee; after that, a refund minus $50 only if the spot is filled, otherwise no refund.
swim_waterfront_notes: Every child must pass a swim check at the start of each session: swim 20 yards and tread water for 2 minutes, wearing a life jacket. Life jackets must be worn at all times on the docks and in boats. Loaner life jackets are available for first-time sailors.
